claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: BU226 is a high-affinity imidazoline I2 ligand with no annotated cytotoxic target; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, with any weak effect reflecting non-specific imidazoline/MAO-related pharmacology rather than a cytotoxic mechanism.
